headline: Three-Month London Copper Hits One-Year Low as AI Asset Rally Fades
summary: Three-month benchmark copper on the London Metal Exchange fell 1.04 percent to $5.3 per pound, touching its lowest level since December 2025 as the rally in artificial intelligence-related assets exhausted itself.
why: Copper is a key industrial metal widely used in electrical infrastructure and manufacturing, serving as a barometer for global economic growth and industrial demand.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Broader market risk-off sentiment and cooling tech optimism push industrial metal prices down.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Fading momentum in technology assets and broader risk aversion drove copper prices down to their lowest level in a year.
